meta.tagline: Weekly conversations on how AI is reshaping work, learning, and opportunity across South Carolina.

episodes.title: From Dutch Fork to Deep Learning: Why AI Literacy Starts at Home
episodes.summary: A field-recording episode from the July SC trip: what Josh heard from librarians, pastors, and small-business owners in Irmo, Columbia, and Greenville about what AI actually means for their day-to-day.

episodes.title: The 46-County Problem: Broadband, Trust, and the AI Divide
episodes.summary: Not every county starts from the same place. We map where South Carolina's connectivity and trust gaps line up with its AI-opportunity gaps — and what closes them.

episodes.title: AI for the Job You Have Now
episodes.summary: Forget replacing workers. We walk through concrete ways a warehouse lead, a nurse, and a church admin in the Upstate are already using AI to get an hour of their day back.

episodes.title: Teaching Grandma to Prompt: AI Literacy for Every Generation
episodes.summary: AI literacy isn't a youth program. We break down how to teach a 70-year-old and a 14-year-old in the same room — and why that mix is a feature, not a bug.

episodes.title: What a Nonprofit Owes Its Community in the Age of AI
episodes.summary: Trust is the whole game. A conversation on transparency, data dignity, and building an AI org that communities actually want in the room.

episodes.title: Why South Carolina, Why Now
episodes.summary: The origin story. Josh lays out the three-phase flywheel — literacy, incubator, fund — and why the AI revolution can either widen or close South Carolina's opportunity gap.
